about: 관리 > 급여계산/대장 [급여대장 ▸ 전표생성](원본 2026-10-21 직접): 확정 대장에서 전표생성 창을 열고, 실지급액 줄 계정이 비면 '계정코드를 입력 바랍니다.', 보통예금을 고르고 저장하면 안내 없이 창이 닫히며 일반전표가 생긴다(지움). 대장도 지운다.

shots.name: 확정 대장 → 전표생성 → 빈 계정 거절 → 보통예금 저장 → 안내 없이 닫힘 → 전표 · 대장 지움
steps: js:(async()=>{for(let i=0;i<30;i++){if(location.pathname!=='/hr/payroll'){history.back();await new Promise(z=>setTimeout(z,1500));continue}const r=[...document.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr')].find(t=>t.innerText.includes('QA급여-전표시험'));if(r&&/[1-9][0-9,]{5,}/.test(r.innerText))return true;await new Promise(z=>setTimeout(z,500))}return true})()

js:(async()=>{const h={Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'};let l;for(let i=0;i<24;i++){const ls=await (await fetch('/api/pay-ledgers',{headers:h})).json();l=ls.find(x=>x.payMonth==='2091-04');if(l&&l.headcount>0)break;await new Promise(z=>setTimeout(z,500))}const c=await fetch('/api/pay-ledgers/'+l.id+'/confirm',{method:'POST',headers:h});sessionStorage.setItem('qaSl',JSON.stringify({id:l.id,n:l.headcount,ok:c.ok}));const out=JSON.stringify({n:l.headcount,s:c.status,g:l.grossTotal});location.reload();return out})()

js:(async()=>{const h={Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'};const js=await (await fetch('/api/journals?from='+new Date().getFullYear()+'-01-01&to='+new Date().getFullYear()+'-12-31',{headers:h})).json();const rows=js.rows;const j=rows.find(x=>(x.description||'').includes('QA급여-전표시험'));sessionStorage.setItem('qaSlJ',JSON.stringify({found:!!j,id:j&&j.id}));if(j)await fetch('/api/journals/'+j.id,{method:'DELETE',headers:h});return true})()
